title: AutoRFP vs Loopio (2026): Features, Reviews, Limitations, and Alternatives
summary: Loopio vs AutoRFP compared on AI, Loopio pricing, onboarding, and G2 ratings, plus who each fits and the AI-native alternative both leave room for. See the verdict.
body_markdown:
If you are choosing[RFP automation software](https://www.inventive.ai/solution/ai-rfp-response-software) , AutoRFP.ai and Loopio will both land on your shortlist, but they solve the problem from opposite ends. Loopio is a mature content-library platform with its Magic AI added on top, built for teams that want a disciplined, reusable knowledge base. AutoRFP.ai is a newer, AI-first tool that drafts from your content and, unusually for this category, publishes its pricing.


This AutoRFP vs Loopio comparison covers what each tool does well, where reviewers say they fall short, what they cost, and where an AI-native option fits for teams that would rather not maintain a library at all.


*Last reviewed: October 2026. This comparison is based on vendor-published materials, verified G2 reviews, and independent third-party analyses. Pricing can change, so confirm current figures with each vendor.*


## **TL;DR**


- Choose AutoRFP.ai for fast AI drafting, unlimited users, and a light setup a lean team can run without heavy onboarding.
- Choose Loopio for a mature, searchable content library, strong collaboration and review workflows, and top-rated support, if you can staff library upkeep and absorb a per-seat bill.
- On G2, AutoRFP.ai holds 4.8/5 (about 60 reviews) and Loopio 4.6/5 (813 reviews). Loopio has the far larger review base; AutoRFP.ai rates higher and sets up faster.
- Both still center on a content library your team maintains and drives step by step. If that upkeep or per-seat pricing is your blocker, an AI-first platform like[Inventive AI](https://www.inventive.ai/) runs intake, drafting, validation, and governance with autonomous agents and unlimited users.

## **What is AutoRFP.ai and how does it work?**


AutoRFP.ai is AI-first software for responding to[RFPs](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/what-is-an-rfp-and-key-components-of-an-effective-rfp) ,[RFIs](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/rfi-request-for-information) ,[DDQs](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/ddq-meaning) , and[security questionnaires](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/how-to-answer-a-security-questionnaire) . Its AI Response Engine turns your existing content into a first draft in minutes and attaches a Trust Score and cited sources, so reviewers can check each response quickly. Approved responses are saved back for reuse, every plan includes unlimited users, and the company sells to teams from startups to the enterprise.


## **What is Loopio and how does it work?**


Loopio is an established RFP and response management platform founded in Toronto in 2014. Teams use Loopio software to respond to RFPs, security questionnaires, and due diligence requests from a centralized content library, with structured workflows, SME assignment, and collaboration. Its "Magic" AI suggests approved answers from that library rather than drafting new ones from scratch.

## **Loopio vs AutoRFP: features, limitations and reviews**


AutoRFP.ai is the faster, lighter pick with pricing you can see upfront. Loopio trades that for a deeper content library, stronger collaboration, and support teams rave about. The honest deciding question is simpler than any feature list: do you have someone to keep a library clean and current? If yes, Loopio pays off. If not, AutoRFP.ai gets you a usable draft without the upkeep. Here is how they compare.


### **AutoRFP.ai best features**


- AI Response Engine drafts answers from your existing content in seconds
- Cited sources with a Trust Score on each draft, for quick verification
- Unlimited users on every plan, with no per-seat cost
- Multi-format import and export across Excel, Word, PDF, and web portals
- [SOC 2](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/soc-2-type-2) and ISO 27001 compliance included on all plans
- [Integrations](https://www.inventive.ai/integrations) across Salesforce, Slack, Teams, SharePoint, Confluence, Notion, Drive, OneDrive, and Box


### **AutoRFP.ai limitations**


- The interface is not intuitive, and it is easy to lose your place in a project.
- There is a steep learning curve, and it is harder to get going without training.
- Keeping content current is still manual, with no automated governance to flag outdated or conflicting responses.
- It handles complex or free-text documents poorly, so messy source files need manual cleanup.
- Templates are rigid and hard to adapt across different RFPs.
- Reporting is thin, with limited visibility into changes contributors make; that’s why enterprises look at[Autorfp alternatives](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/autorfp-alternatives) .


### **AutoRFP.ai pricing**


- Scale:[$899 per month](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/autorfp-ai-pricing-features-reviews) , billed annually, for up to 24 projects per year
- Accelerate: $1,299 per month, billed annually, for up to 50 projects per year
- Enterprise: custom pricing for higher volume
- Every plan includes unlimited users, SSO, integrations, and compliance, with no paid add-ons


### **AutoRFP.ai ratings and reviews**


- G2: 4.8/5 (about 60 reviews)
- Gartner Peer Insights: 4.8/5 (21 reviews)

*According to G2,* Lisa R. praised AutoRFP.ai for improving team collaboration and customer support, while Kristen C. noted that the interface has a learning curve, particularly when navigating ongoing projects. ****

### **Loopio best features**


- Centralized content library with stacks, categories, and tags
- Magic AI for one-click answer suggestions from approved content
- Milestone tracking and SME assignment for project management
- Content analytics for library health and completion tracking
- Chrome extension for filling out questionnaires inside client portals
- Strong collaborative review workflows and top-rated customer support


### **Loopio limitations**


- AI is limited to suggesting matches from a static library; it does not generate context-aware drafts, so responses often still need rewriting
- No conflict detection; contradictory or outdated answers across the library go unnoticed unless a human catches them
- No competitive intelligence agents to research competitors or build win themes
- No deal-specific personalization; every buyer gets answers pulled from the same global library
- Per-seat pricing penalizes teams that need to loop in many occasional SMEs
- Manual library upkeep is required and gets harder without a dedicated owner, a common reason teams start exploring[Loopio alternatives](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/loopio-alternatives)


### **Loopio pricing**


- [Loopio pricing](https://www.inventive.ai/blog-posts/loopio-pricing-features-reviews) is quote-based, with a per-seat subscription model and no public list price
- [According to Vendr transaction data](https://www.vendr.com/marketplace/loopio) , typical annual contracts range from $15,000 to $150,000 or more
- Mid-market deployments (10 to 25 users) commonly fall around the $60,000 per year range
- Onboarding runs 15 to 30 days, with professional-services onboarding for larger rollouts


### **Loopio ratings and reviews**


- G2: 4.6/5 (813 reviews)
- Capterra: 4.6/5
- TrustRadius: 8/10

[According to G2, Ritesh P](https://www.g2.com/products/loopio/reviews?page=2) ., Proposal Coordinator at an enterprise company, praised Loopio's intuitive interface, organized content library, and easy setup, but noted that Loopio Magic often failed to surface the most relevant answers despite having the right content in the library.

## **AutoRFP vs Loopio: AI-native feature comparison**


A side-by-side look at the AI-native capabilities[proposal](https://www.inventive.ai/solution/rfp-ai-response-software-for-proposal-teams) and[security teams](https://www.inventive.ai/solution/it-and-security-teams) screen for, from autonomous agents to content governance, and how much of each AutoRFP.ai and Loopio actually deliver.


### **AI agents for end-to-end automation**


- **AutoRFP.ai:** Partial. It produces a first draft from your content, then a person handles intake, review, and submission, so it speeds the draft rather than running the whole response.
- **Loopio:** No end-to-end agent. Loopio runs a human-in-the-loop model where Magic AI surfaces matching answers from your approved library and a person places and edits them.


### **Go/no-go and bid qualification**


- **AutoRFP.ai:** Offers an AI Go/No-Go Agent that scores opportunity fit with weighted criteria, red-flag detection, and win-theme suggestions. It ships as a downloadable agent skill (for Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, and Grok), and AutoRFP says the same evidence-based scoring can run against your approved library inside the platform.
- **Loopio:** Available as a paid add-on. It scores opportunity fit and lets you weigh named competitors to support the qualification decision, so confirm it is included in your plan.


### **Automatic response analyzer**


- **AutoRFP.ai:** Review runs at the answer level through Trust Scores and cited sources, rather than one pass across the full document.
- **Loopio:** No full-response analyzer. Quality control is manual, answer by answer through SME review, so catching gaps or contradictions across a long response depends on a reviewer.


### **Automatic content governance**


- **AutoRFP.ai:** Limited. It saves approved responses for reuse, but nothing automatically flags outdated or conflicting content, so keeping the library accurate stays a manual job.
- **Loopio:** Partial. Response Intelligence detects duplicates, cleans up content, and enriches metadata to keep the library tidy, but keeping answers accurate and current still depends on a content owner.


### **Integrations**


- **AutoRFP.ai:** Connects to Salesforce, Slack, Teams, SharePoint, Confluence, Notion, Drive, OneDrive, and Box, plus sourcing platforms such as Ariba, Workday, and Jaggaer, with the connector roadmap still expanding.
- **Loopio:** Connects to Salesforce and HubSpot for CRM, Slack and Teams for collaboration, and 80+ content sources such as SharePoint and Google Drive, plus a Chrome extension for client portals.


### **Analytics**


- **AutoRFP.ai:** Project and content analytics aimed at keeping a focused team's content current and projects on track.
- **Loopio:** Reporting on library health, proposal performance, and response completion times, aimed at keeping a team's content current and projects on schedule.


### **User interface**


- **AutoRFP.ai:** Light and fast, though reviewers report navigation friction, such as losing track of where a project stands.
- **Loopio:** Users consistently call the interface clean and intuitive and easy to train new people on, which is one of the top reasons teams pick it, though some report the export step feels clunky.

## Frequently Asked Questions


### AutoRFP.ai vs Loopio: which is better?


It depends on your team. AutoRFP.ai is better for lean teams that want fast AI drafting, open pricing, and unlimited users, and it rates higher on G2 (4.8 versus 4.6). Loopio is better for teams that want a mature content library, strong collaboration, and top-rated support, and it has a far larger review base.


### How credible is Loopio for governed, enterprise use?


Credible and established: founded in 2014, SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certified, 4.6/5 on G2 from 813 reviews, with role-based permissions, approval workflows, and a governed library. The limitation is that governance is manual, with no automated conflict detection, so accuracy at scale depends on a content owner.


### Which is easier to use, AutoRFP or Loopio?


Both are well rated for usability. Loopio is consistently praised as clean, intuitive, and easy to train new people on, which is its top-cited strength. AutoRFP.ai is lighter and quicker to set up, though reviewers note the interface is not always intuitive.


### Which has better AI, AutoRFP or Loopio?


AutoRFP.ai has the more generative AI: it writes a first response from your content and attaches cited sources and a Trust Score. Loopio's Magic AI finds and suggests matching answers from your approved library rather than composing new ones. Teams that want the AI to handle the full response usually look at AI-native platforms such as Inventive AI.


### How much do AutoRFP and Loopio cost?


AutoRFP.ai publishes its plans: Scale at $899 per month billed annually for up to 24 projects a year, and Accelerate at $1,299 per month billed annually for up to 50 projects, both with unlimited users. Loopio pricing is quote-based and per-seat, with no public list price; third-party data puts typical contracts between $15,000 and $150,000 or more per year.


### Which is better for enterprise versus a smaller team?


Loopio is built for teams standardizing a large, governed content library across many contributors, with enterprise rollouts in 4 to 6 weeks. AutoRFP.ai fits leaner teams that value speed, open pricing, and unlimited users. Teams that want AI-native automation at either size also compare Inventive AI.


### How do I migrate from AutoRFP or Loopio to another tool?


Both AutoRFP.ai and Loopio let you export your response library, so your approved content moves with you. Migrations tend to be shorter when the new tool connects to your live sources and de-duplicates as it imports, instead of asking you to rebuild the library. Ask each vendor about supported import formats and a realistic go-live timeline for your team size.


### Is there an AI-native alternative to AutoRFP and Loopio?


Yes. Looking past Loopio alternatives and AutoRFP alternatives, AI-native platforms such as Inventive AI change the model entirely: agents draft from your connected knowledge, keep it current, review the full response, and flag risks, with unlimited users and go-live in days.
